chunks: Remember, when We asked the angels to bow in homage to Adam, they all bowed but Iblis, who disdained and turned insolent, and so became a disbeliever.
ai.seo_question: Why did Iblis refuse to prostrate to Adam?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse establishes Adam's cosmic vicegerency and the angels' obedience as a testament to divine wisdom, while Iblis's refusal highlights the distinction between created beings who obey by nature and those who choose rebellion. The term 'kafara' (disbelieved) is interpreted not merely as denial but as a rejection of the truth of Adam's elevated status, marking the origin of spiritual arrogance. This event serves as a foundational paradigm for human potential and the test of free will, contrasting the humility of the faithful with the pride of the devil.
